svg.text: ALEX EDGE: trim, butt to the cabinet edge
ALEX EDGE: trim, butt to the cabinet edge
T1 · P10 locating ring + P20 ALEX foot (opt.) · rev 2026-10-23
SHEET FACE UP on the ALEX top, the two edge lines on
the two edges of one corner. Same sheet for all
eight corners: turn it, never flip it.
1 Tape down. 2 Awl or punch each RING centre
through the paper. 3 Lift the sheet. 4 Pilot 5/64
in, 12 mm deep (puck 12 ALEX). 5 #6 × 5/8 in flat
head, 13 mm into the ALEX top.
the paper on it, butt it
ALEX foot: r 14.5 at the same
